about: The census's ledger (this repository): the measures that may only fall or hold (lab/release-check/census-ratchet.mjs MEASURES), for the tree NOW and for AFTER (NOW less what the cut-over deletes), as the last integrated round measured them. Generated by `node lab/release-check/census.mjs --record`, never edited by hand; a value is raised only by `--record --raise=<measure> --reason="…"`, kept below in `raises` with its reason and commit.
